provenance.prompt: Create an original editorial illustration for Project Odisha’s Pioneers profile of textile researcher B. C. Mohanty. Landscape 3:2 composition. A close study of a small red, cream and muted indigo Odisha-inspired ikat textile swatch on an open plain research notebook, with a wooden ruler and a few loose cotton threads. Clearly hand-rendered graphite linework and restrained watercolour on warm ivory paper, quiet scholarly attention, selective detail around the weave and softened blank background. Show the subtle feathered boundaries of resist-dyed yarn motifs; simple geometrical pattern, no invented sacred lettering. The notebook has only sparse abstract pencil marks, no readable words, signatures, titles or claims. Objects have believable proportions and fabric folds. No person, no portrait, no photographed historical scene, no exact reconstruction of a museum specimen, no decorative temple collage, no logos, no border. This is a conceptual illustration of textile documentation, not a reproduction of a book cover. Visually dignified and natural, not glossy or excessively distressed.
